dedupe_keys.name: urban wind wake fourier operator research suite

description: This Sustainable Urban Systems Lab repository provides training and diagnostic software for urban wind-wake prediction. It compares standard, hybrid convolutional, physics-informed and geometry-conditioned Fourier operator architectures, with shared configuration and multi-GPU execution scripts. Inputs are prepared urban-flow training arrays, geometry information and model settings; outputs are trained surrogates and metrics such as wake-region error, gradient correlation and structural similarity. Domain extent and resolution are dataset-dependent, with no common city or period established in the README. Code is free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that the workflow is tailored to a SLURM cluster and large model comparisons; its strong physical-accuracy claims were not independently tested and should not be treated as guarantees. The suite can support surrogate development for building and street wind simulations. FNO-3DUM (model-fno-3dum) is a related published urban-flow model. No training arrays, checkpoints or cluster jobs were accessed.
